text: I am running for a seat on the Bassett Unified School District Board. I care deeply about our schools, my years of working with young people and families have strengthened my commitment to public service. As a proud community member and former Bassett student, I understand the importance of effective, transparent, and accountable board leadership."

Our district faces significant challenges, including declining enrollment, and educational funding cuts. I believe we can meet these challenges by staying focused on what matters most for our students. My priorities are to:

- Improve student academics and educational opportunities.
- Encourage family and community participation.
- Promote transparency and responsible district leadership.
- Support student well-being, including mental health resources and extracurricular programs.
Every student deserves a safe, supportive, and challenging learning environment.

My candidacy is personal to me. It is rooted in service, not politics. With my experience as a professional, and a parent, I am committed to decisions that put students first so they can feel seen and supported.
"I would be honored to earn your vote. Together, we can build stronger schools, support our teachers and students, and create a brighter future for every child in Bassett Unified."

Respectfully,
Carol Tula

text: Occupation: Board President, Bassett Unified School District
Dear Community,

Bassett is ready for its transformation. We need leadership who'll see it through. As the candidate for re-election who graduated from our K-12 schools and a first-generation transfer graduate from Rio Hondo College and UCLA, I understand the struggles our students face and the resources they need to succeed.

strong: During my term of service, I
have championed real change for our students.

text: We've expanded college/career pathways, invested in new textbooks and technology, and boosted mental health support. We've secured historic pay increases for our dedicated teachers and staff, all while maintaining ongoing fiscal health and reserves. We've invested in new playgrounds, athletic facilities, modernized CTE classroom spaces, and critical infrastructure repairs. Bassett has been my lifelong home. As your neighbor and board president, I lead countywide and statewide organizations to fight for the educational dollars our students deserve. Our schools need an energetic leader with vision and creativity to guide us into the future.

strong: My values will always be integrity, service, and excellence.

text: Together with our students, families, teachers and staff, I'll continue to be the leader the next generation is counting on. I hope I've earned your support.
With gratitude

text: Occupation: Special Education Teacher

As a Bassett USD Board incumbent, I have been a resident of this community for 70 years. I am a teacher with over four decades of K-12 experience and have always been committed to advocating for the needs of all Bassett students, particularly those in special education and English language learning programs, including Foster and Homeless youth. Addressing at-risk students is critical as well. My extensive background in education has equipped me with a deep understanding of the challenges our schools face. I continue to prioritize student safety and well-being, recognizing that a secure and supportive environment is essential for academic achievement. I advocate for higher academic standards because I am convinced that every student can improve with the right resources and support.

Additionally, I am dedicated to supporting our staff, as I am a teacher Union officer, where I teach, ensuring that educators have the tools and conditions necessary to foster a thriving learning atmosphere for our children. I am confident in setting Bassett Unified goals, visions, and policies. I understand the importance of a balanced budget, accountability, and complete transparency. I bring proven integrity, experience, and lifelong commitment to education for the Board position. Vote Patrice Stanzione

text: Bassett deserves a champion who loves our community, believes in our students, and has a vision for our schools. I am running for the Bassett Unified School District Governing Board to help make Bassett a destination district families choose.

As an educator and community organizer, I teach environmental literacy and leadership curriculum that I helped develop. As a Bassett Personnel Commissioner, I helped lead the first comprehensive update of Commission bylaws since 2012 to comply with current law and strengthen employee representation.
My focus is the fundamentals: improving academic achievement, getting every student reading and writing at grade level, and creating safe, healthy schools.

Education must also open doors. I want students graduating with real choices through stronger Career Technical Education, skilled trades, expanded community college dual enrollment, FFA, and renewed partnerships like our Health Academy with Kaiser.
I want students proud to be part of Bassett. We can strengthen that connection through mariachi, folklórico, environmental education, and a Green Schools Initiative.
My vision is a Bassett where employees are valued, families are proud to enroll, and every student graduates prepared for college, a career, or a skilled trade.
I would be honored to have your vote.
